_comment: Reference values for lammps-minimize-var-bug. Calibrated on x86_64 with compchem-bench/lammps-minimize-var-bug:ci (LAMMPS 7Jan2022).
_calibration_note: Porphin (C20H14N4, 40 atoms) with GAFF2, min_style cg, minimize 1.0e-4 1.0e-6 1000 10000, single-threaded. 5 oracle runs produced identical e_initial/e_final/delta_e and 120 iterations (spread 0.0 — the minimisation is deterministic). energy_tol/recompute_tol 0.05 kcal/mol sits far above thermo print resolution and far below the 907.7 kcal/mol drop the task is about. n_iterations_tol 5 absorbs any line-search step-count jitter across builds. The layer-7 generalisation probe displaces every atom by up to probe_amplitude_ang along each axis (deterministic, mean-zero); probe_min_separation asserts the resulting e_initial moved by more than 1.0 kcal/mol so the probe can actually discriminate a hardcoded report (observed separation ~275 kcal/mol), and probe_tol matches energy_tol. Calibrated twice on two independently built images (the apt/pip layer above the pinned base is not byte-reproducible, so image_digest changes across rebuilds while the LAMMPS binary does not); all 10 oracle runs across both images produced bit-identical values, so image_digest records the image these references were measured on rather than a constraint on the build.
